name: rgou-cloudflare
description: Offline-first Royal Game of Ur with Rust/WebAssembly AI opponents on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm-assets && npm run generate:sw && vite
scripts.build: rm -rf out && npm run generate:sw && npm run build:wasm-assets && npm run type-check && vite build && node scripts/generate-sw.js --built
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config out/rgou_main/wrangler.json
scripts.check:docs: node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node --test scripts/format-ai-matrix-md.test.cjs && node scripts/generate-ai-page.mjs --check
scripts.lint:rust: cd worker/rust_ai_core && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.build:wasm: cd worker/rust_ai_core && wasm-pack build --target web --out-name rgou_ai_worker -- --features wasm --no-default-features
scripts.build:wasm-assets: npm run build:wasm && rm -rf public/wasm && mkdir -p public/wasm && cp worker/rust_ai_core/pkg/rgou_ai_worker_bg.wasm public/wasm/rgou_ai_worker_bg.wasm && cp worker/rust_ai_core/pkg/rgou_ai_worker.js public/wasm/rgou_ai_core.js
scripts.nuke: rm -rf out .wrangler node_modules && npm ci && npm run dev
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:docs && npm run check:diagrams && npm run type-check && npm run lint:rust && npm run test:rust && npm run test:service-worker && npm run test:smoke-production && npm run test:model-provenance && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check:slow: npm run lint && npm run check:docs && npm run check:diagrams && npm run type-check && npm run lint:rust && (cd worker/rust_ai_core && RUN_SLOW_TESTS=1 cargo test --features slow_tests -- --nocapture) && npm run test:service-worker && npm run test:smoke-production && npm run test:model-provenance && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:model-provenance: python3 -m unittest discover -s ml/tests -v && python3 ml/scripts/model_provenance.py verify && python3 ml/scripts/oracle_provenance.py verify
scripts.test:rust:slow: cd worker/rust_ai_core && RUN_SLOW_TESTS=1 cargo test --features slow_tests -- --nocapture
scripts.test:ai-deployed: cd worker/rust_ai_core && AI_MATRIX_DEPLOYED_ONLY=1 NUM_GAMES=400 cargo test test_ai_matrix -- --nocapture
scripts.test:ai-candidate: cd worker/rust_ai_core && AI_MATRIX_COMPARE_CANDIDATE=1 NUM_GAMES=400 cargo test test_ai_matrix -- --nocapture
scripts.test:e2e: VITE_E2E=true npm run build && playwright test --reporter=line
scripts.test:e2e:ui: VITE_E2E=true npm run build && playwright test --ui
scripts.evolve:genetic-params: cd worker/rust_ai_core && caffeinate cargo run --release --bin evolve_params
scripts.validate:genetic-params: cd worker/rust_ai_core && caffeinate cargo test test_genetic_params_comparison -- --nocapture
